routes.name: MBA
routes.entry: Bachelor in any field; most schools ask for an entrance test and interview
routes.about: Leadership and management track. Work experience before an MBA increases its value a lot.

routes.name: MBS (Master of Business Studies)
routes.entry: BBS or an equivalent management bachelor
routes.about: Low-cost master at TU campuses, often studied with a full-time job.

routes.name: MA (Arts and Social Sciences)
routes.about: Gives eligibility for lecturer posts and strengthens civil service answers.

routes.name: MEd (Education)
routes.entry: BEd or bachelor with education subjects
routes.about: Raises your level in the teacher service and opens school leadership roles.

routes.name: ME or MSc Engineering
routes.about: Specialisations include structures, energy, geotechnics, ICT and data. Many join research or lecture after it.

routes.name: MSc Computer Science / IT
routes.about: Deeper study in AI, data, security or software engineering.

routes.name: MD or MS (Medical specialist)
routes.about: Specialist training in medicine, surgery and many branches. Competitive seats, with a service bond on scholarship seats.

routes.name: MSc Nursing
routes.about: Teaching, specialist clinical roles and nursing leadership.

routes.name: MPharm
routes.about: Clinical pharmacy, pharmaceutics and industry quality roles.

routes.name: MSc Agriculture
routes.about: Research and extension, with many fellowships.

routes.name: MSW (Social Work)
routes.about: Leadership in NGOs and development programmes.

routes.name: CA, ACCA and CMA professional route
routes.entry: +2 or bachelor; exemptions depend on your degree
routes.about: Chartered Accountancy through ICAN, and ACCA or CMA with international recognition. Low pass rates, high reward.

routes.name: Lok Sewa (civil service)
routes.entry: Bachelor degree for officer level, +2 for assistant level, with age limits
routes.about: Written exam, then interview. Preparation classes help but self study works. Vacancies are announced by the Public Service Commission.

routes.name: Teaching licence (TSC)
routes.about: Licence is needed for permanent posts in community schools.

routes.name: Study abroad (Bachelor or Master)
routes.entry: Language test (IELTS, TOEFL or PTE), transcripts, a statement and funds proof
routes.about: Public universities in Germany, Norway and Finland have low or no tuition. The UK, Australia, Canada and the US cost more. See the Abroad and Scholarships tabs.
routes.exam: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE; GRE or GMAT for some programmes
